note: Draft 1. One remark, MAJOR: 25:5 odívi has present sense → ‘Odeio’. Taken. «A tradução é fiel ao latim nos demais versículos»; marks confirmed.

outcomes.remark: odívi (perfect of odi) has present sense; 'Odiei' puts it in the past

note: Draft 1. Four verses; best 25:8, worst 25:10. «O salmo tem sobriedade e imagens fortes … Os principais tropeços estão nas inversões e em algumas escolhas livrescas.» Two taken, one taken in its order and refused in its word, one refused with an option.

outcomes.remark: 'me comprazi' bookish → 'achei prazer na vossa verdade'
long complement before the verb; 'fazem coisas iníquas' heavy → 'e não entrarei com os que praticam iniquidades'
outcomes.reason: 'praticar' is operári iniquitátem's; his order ends the verse on a proparoxytone; the verb last is the Latin's and gives the cadence.

outcomes.remark: vocative in mid-colon → 'Deus, não façais perecer com os ímpios a minha alma'
inversion sounds literary; 'dádivas' solemn → 'a direita deles está cheia de presentes'
outcomes.reason: The order taken; the word refused for the glossary (múnera → dádivas, 14:4b); 'presentes' is the row's option and stays selectable.

note: Draft 1. 21 items, 3 unknown words (comprazi, iníquas, iniquidades). Two wrong first hearings mended: 25:2 'tentai-me' heard as 'lead me into sin' → 'experimentai-me'; 25:4 'com o conselho da vaidade' heard as advice → 'no conselho'. Heard rightly: 'andei na minha inocência', 'cercarei o vosso altar' (going round it), 'homens de sangue' (violent men), 25:12 (steadfast conduct, the foot's image kept). Known costs kept: 'esperando no Senhor' heard as waiting (glossary speráre in); 'vaidade' heard as conceit (glossary vánitas); 'Lavarei as minhas mãos' heard as disclaiming responsibility — the Latin's own image, from which the idiom comes; 'queimai os meus rins' heard literally — the Latin's image.

outcomes.remark: 'tentai-me' heard first as 'induce me to sin'
'o conselho da vaidade' heard first as advice

outcomes.reason: The glossary's word (vánitas); the row already records the cost and its option 'do que é vão'.
The glossary's iníquus → iníquo; a word of the Church's register kept psalter-wide.

outcomes.remark: 'Lavarei as minhas mãos' heard as disclaiming responsibility
outcomes.reason: The Latin's image; the Portuguese idiom comes from it; the Lavabo keeps it.

note: ps025/revise_v2.py: 25:2 'experimentai-me'; 25:3 'achei prazer na vossa verdade'; 25:4 'no conselho da vaidade'; 25:5 'Odeio' (the Latinist's major); 25:9 vocative first; 25:10 natural order again ('a direita deles está cheia de dádivas').
